title: Hash-7777/HashCortX
summary: A local-first AI workspace : multi provider chat, a Full Harness in Hashcoder agent, 3D models, ERPs, and multi-agent swarms in one native desktop app. No backend. No telemetry. No account. MIT-licensed.

title: ShamelesAbyss/Nyx
summary: NYX Eclipse AI — a free, open-source, local-first Android AI workstation with native GGUF inference, autonomous objectives, real execution tools, and evidence-verified workflows. Kotlin + Jetpack Compose.

title: sugarforever/chat-ollama
summary: ChatOllama is an open source agentic app for running AI agents across local and hosted models.

title: roloVibes/Halo-Harness
summary: Multi-agent, multi-workflow harness with a live view of what every model is thinking and doing. Compose and steer orchestrations visually, mix any models in one job, first-class local LLM support, Claude Code compatible.

title: pacphi/organize-my-iphone
summary: Scan the apps on a USB-connected iPhone from your Mac, classify them with a local model, preview tidier Home Screen layouts, then apply one or restore the old one.

title: Dextron04/dex-notch
summary: The Mac notch, wired to every AI you use. One hotkey for Gemma, Claude and Codex, plus a shared memory vault they all read. No API keys.

title: cogwheel0/conduit
summary: Native iOS and Android client for Open WebUI, direct OpenAI-compatible, Ollama, and Hermes agents.

title: UnimeType/transliteration
summary: On-device 12-language IME transliteration engines (0.8B / 4B / 9B, Apache-2.0) — zero-system-prompt unimetype-convert-short-v3 protocol, Ollama Modelfiles, Apple Silicon MLX, llama.cpp & LM Studio launchers.

title: ArvinLovegood/go-stock
summary: 🦄🦄🦄AI赋能股票分析：AI加持的股票分析/选股工具。股票行情获取，AI热点资讯分析，AI资金/财务分析，涨跌报警推送。支持A股，港股，美股。支持市场整体/个股情绪分析，AI辅助选股等。数据全部保留在本地。支持DeepSeek，OpenAI， Ollama，LMStudio，AnythingLLM，硅基流动，火山方舟，阿里云百炼等平台或模型。

title: Panto92/Opencognit
summary: OpenCognit Desktop — every coding agent in one window. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Kimi and Hermes side by side, orchestrated and checked. Local, no telemetry.

title: Matty321/nido
summary: Native virtual machines on Apple silicon: a SwiftUI app and the nido command. Private by default: controlled network, no shared folders until you add one.

title: ldbumble/taskuary
summary: Your AI work partner. Mail, chats and tickets become one list in the right order; your agents do the work, and nothing goes out until you approve. Free, open source, runs on your computer.

title: Wulfgardr/mediflow
summary: Gestionale gratuito e a codice aperto per cartelle cliniche, documenti e attività ambulatoriali. Utilizzabile anche senza intelligenza artificiale.

title: Clufy/ai-resume-analyzer
summary: AI resume analyzer and job matcher: parse PDF/DOCX resumes, score semantic match against job descriptions, and get LLM career feedback via Ollama (DeepSeek, Mistral). Built with FastAPI, Next.js 15 and Supabase.

title: irie-people/irie
summary: Runs your AI coding agents side by side, in one calm view

title: code-forge-temple/agentic-signal
summary: 🤖 Visual AI agent workflow automation platform with local LLM integration - build intelligent workflows using drag-and-drop interface, no cloud dependencies required.

title: profullstack/c0mpute
summary: Open compute network: run a node with one command and help pool 100,000 CPUs/GPUs for open-weight AI. Inference, transcoding, storage. CLI-first, MIT.

title: codewhale-hq/Codewhale
summary: An open-source coding agent for your terminal, written in Rust. It works with any model, can split one task across several agents, and every line of it is yours to read.

title: HaseebKhalid1507/Axon
summary: Fast, cheap LLM inference engine written from scratch in Rust + CUDA. Runs GGUF models (Qwen, Llama, Gemma, Mistral, MoE) on CPU and NVIDIA GPUs, with an OpenAI / Responses / ollama-compatible server. No ggml, no BLAS.

title: raydendejesus/echo
summary: Echo: a private AI voice assistant that runs on your own PC. Wake word, vision, memory, phone calls, Spotify, browser control and smart TV, powered by a local LLM (Ollama). Windows + NVIDIA. Free and open source (MIT).
